newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS weak but 135.40 resistance beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS weak but 135.40 resistance beckons.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will eye resistance at 135.40 on Thursday, but could be unsettled by key U.S. payroll data later in the session, analysts said.
"I think they'll try to test trend resistance at 135.40," Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data, said.
BTPs were quoted at 134.80 at 0742 GMT, down 22 basis points from Wednesday's settlement.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, noted that that trendline held the contract back in Wednesday's trade.
"This line was able to hold strength prompting retreats into the close and it is clear this must be broken to bring about a sustainable advance," he said in a research note.
Jones added that while daily momentum was building up, the market was looking overbought. The 14-day relative strength index was reading 70.802 in early trade.
She said support from hourly charts surfaced at 134.70/73 and further down at 134.38/40.
"Today's low volume could exaggerate any moves lower," Jones said. "Any sharp fall will see support at 134.08, based on a June 19 trend support line," Jones said.
Adcock also said the upside would be hard going.
"One interesting factor is the stochastics continue to trace out a bearish formation," he said. "This continues to place us on a cautious footing until a clear upside breaks develops."
At the short end, September Eurolire were quoted at 93.50, down 0.03 on the day.
A Reuter poll forecast U.S. June payrolls would rise to 222,000 from 138,000 the previous month, with the unemployment rate static at 4.8 percent.
